title: HYDT — MintV2 Price Manipulation for Excess Token Minting Analysis
root_cause: `MintV2.initialMint()` calculates HYDT mint amount using the spot price from `getReserves()` of the WBNB-USDT Pair — manipulating the reserve ratio allows excessive HYDT minting
steps: [3] ► Half of minted HYDT → USDT swap (V3 Router)
